title: A batch of Notion MCP operations emitted by exec.py (notion diff / notion poll-plan): .execution/local/notion/batches/<batch_id>.json
description: The orchestrator (main thread only) executes the ops in array order, calling the Notion MCP tool whose name ends with `tool` (prefix discovered at runtime: mcp__claude_ai_Notion__, mcp__notion__, mcp__plugin_Notion_notion__), with `args` passed verbatim, at most 3 calls in flight, honouring rate_limited/retry_after_seconds. After each call it runs `exec.py notion ack --batch <id> --op <op_id> --result-file <file with the raw tool result>` (or --failed). Ops never reference results of other ops in the same batch: anything that needs an id from an earlier call is emitted in a later stage by the next `notion diff`. An update is done only after notion-get-async-task returns succeeded (ack of an async_task result schedules that poll as the next stage).

stage.description: 1 for the first batch of a sequence; a later stage is emitted by the next notion diff once earlier ops are acked.

query_calls.description: notion-query-data-sources calls (20 per 10 s limit); always view mode (quota-free).

followup.description: What to run after the batch, e.g. 'exec.py notion diff' (next stage) or 'exec.py answers ingest --from-notion <file>'.

args.description: Exact MCP arguments. Rows are written with allow_async false on creates. Dates go as date:<prop>:start ISO strings in UTC plus a 'Due text' rich-text column with the display zones.

hash.description: On a successful ack, recorded as local/state.json notion.hashes[key].

capture.description: What notion ack extracts from the raw result: JSON pointers into the parsed result, stored under a name (page:<key>, db:tasks, ds:tasks, view:<name>, async:<key>).

replay_of.description: batch_id/op_id of the outbox entry this op replays.

row_hashes.description: Multi-page create-row ops: row key -> row_hash of each page (key and hash above are the first page's), recorded per page by notion ack.
